## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 5, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.42, contribution -0.62) [F2]; caption mismatch; AI check 18/20 · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.08, contribution -0.61) [F3]; AI check 19/20 · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.02, contribution +0.43) [F4]; AI check 20/20 · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score (1.19, contribution -0.32); AI check 12/20 · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Low score (0.20, contribution -0.21); AI check 0/20, unreliable · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI includes 0: -0.009 to +0.006); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation and 100th-percentile OOD distort features; 3/5 neighbors are InSitu or Invasive (BACH_0138, 82% similar).
- Focal invasion or DCIS exists in higher-risk regions 1 (44%), 4 (20%), or 6 (8%), affecting 19%–23% margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4, 6**: Inspect highest heatmap risk areas (44%, 20%, 8%) and region 6 stroma.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 11**: Verify clear superior (23%), medial (23%), and lateral (19%) frozen-section margins.
3. **Regions 3, 5, 8, 9, 10**: Confirm benign tubules over duct-confined atypia and TILs versus invasive BACH_0138.
